_source: Not captured from a live project. Each body follows the response schema in Google's REST reference for that method (oauth2 token exchange; Cloud SQL Admin v1 instances.list, a list of DatabaseInstance; Cloud Storage JSON v1 buckets.list, a list of Bucket), with example values, trimmed to the fields the gcp connector reads, written 2026-11-11. Cloud Run and Compute are absent: the connector skips an API that answers with an error, as it does for one that is not enabled. Replace with captured responses.
